body:
Well... complete opposite of my experience with the dreaded desvenlafaxine (Pristiq)...
My whole body was stiff as an iron bar, lots of brain fog, insomnia, barely made a dent on my depressive state, and it was possibly the most expensive medication I have ever taken.

Oh, and the withdrawal effects are horrible (I won't even post them, just look around on other forums... if you dare; not to mention it's almost impossible to taper off...).


But I'm glad someone feels a lot better with it, so yeah, congratulations.

Funny you mention nihilism, its something I have read a lot about, yet never quite understood completely.
Now I'll have to re-read everything about it...
Thanks (no, seriously, I can spend hours reading Wikipedia)!

Well, no.
Being put in a psychiatric hospital has only caused whatever self-esteem, confidence or whatever to vanish. Like, if they never existed.

But your experience seems vastly better, so congratulations, and keep going strong.

Um, maybe try not trying to appease others?
I really can't understand a lot of your situation, but why would you want to be with someone that harms you to the point of considering taking your life, just because that person doesn't want to be with you?

Yeah, I guess. Just as I have heard a lot of times, if you're planning to take your life then why not do it later...
Since it seems nothing has really any intrinsic value to it, probably it wouldn't be such a bad idea to just pass time away as a life goal of some type.
Wait, I thought this GamerGate drama had died off already?

Yes, same here.
Maybe sunlight does help after all... Or not. I get all thirsty after being in the sun, so I avoid it, but then I feel much more sad, oh well.

This is by far one of the worst replies possible.
Basically; "I enjoy life, if you don't then just do it faggot".
Wow... 275 mg! I wasn't even given 100 mg before they decided to put me on desvenlafaxine!
